title: Santa's Workshop 16" Silver Elegance Angel Tree Topper

comparisons.notes: Santa's Workshop 16in Silver Elegance Angel (HSN item 120-8105), model 3032; same silver dress with lace front, silver harp, white feather wings, 16in height. In stock, not waitlisted; $7.50 S&H extra.

writeup: Woot has the Santa's Workshop 16" Silver Elegance Angel tree topper, new, for $25.99. HSN sells the same angel (model 3032) for $59.99 plus $7.50 shipping, so this is about 56% below other stores. She wears a silver lace-front dress with white feather wings and holds a silver harp, and Woot caps it at 3 per customer.
